orderingSteps.title: Share your brief
orderingSteps.description: Tell us about the occasion, preferred design and any reference images.

orderingSteps.title: Discuss the details
orderingSteps.description: We will discuss suitable embroidery options and clarify your requirements.

orderingSteps.title: Review your quote
orderingSteps.description: We will share the price and estimated timeline for your requested work.

orderingSteps.title: Confirm your order
orderingSteps.description: Proceed after you have reviewed and approved the agreed details.
